guardrails: Before the first A2 write, verify CONTINUATION.json and STATUS.json against live canonical files.
Use the exact A2 unit themes/genres/domains from topic_genre_matrix.json; do not duplicate the full roadmap in this derived file.
Generate in guarded unit or large bounded batches, not one workflow per passage.
Preserve 6 passages per unit and the active 10-question/10-answer contract unless a documented pedagogical exception applies.
Write natural independent Urdu rather than translating Arabic or French passages.
Fix obvious severe defects immediately; defer repeated formal release audits until the designated review phase.
Do not interpret Urdu A1 integrity PASS as educator/publication release approval.
on_frontier_change: Update this file, reading/CONTINUATION.json, reading/STATUS.json, and reading/TASKS.md together.
Update reading/RELEASE_STATUS.json only if release evidence changes.
